parsed.observations: Wheat leaves show numerous small, round to oval orange-brown pustules scattered across the blades, with dense patches on foreground leaves. Some lower leaves are yellowing and drying. No distinct pustule stripes, elongated stem pustules, white powdery growth, or black-dotted necrotic lesions are visible.
parsed.summary: Leaf rust is indicated by abundant scattered orange-brown, round to oval pustules on the wheat leaf blades.
